title: Design rating and safe working load for general purpose flat pallet for through transit of goods
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11982) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Design rating and safe working load for general purpose flat pallet for through transit of goods.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Methods of Test for General Purpose Flat Pallets for Through Transit of Goods

clause_3_terminology: Design rating and safe working load for general purpose flat pallet for through transit of goods

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
